160 State Street

Boston, Massachusetts

Building

Overview

Perched at the foot of one of Boston’s most iconic streets,160 State Street presents an exceptional locale, boasting immediate access to Faneuil Hall Marketplace, Rose Kennedy Greenway, and the picturesque Boston Harbor waterfront, all while being mere steps away from the MBTA and minutes from I-93 with multiple nearby parking options.

The area provides no shortage of amenities with restaurants, shops and green space just steps from the front door. The common areas of the building just went through a complete upgrade creating a new and vibrant space for tenants and their employees.

Highlights

Newly renovated lobby

On-site restaurant

2 high speed elevators

Base building systems recently upgraded
Full-floor suites

Three sides of windows provide abundant natural light and views of the waterfront

Flexible layouts
